title: Recover a queue ejection before release enrollment
trigger: A queued PR is unmergeable in its train while it remains mergeable against the base, or an item has an open correction landing.
need: Read the snapshotted preceding PRs and shared files. Wait until those entries land or leave, then re-read base mergeability: rebase and re-verify a conflicting head; re-enqueue an unchanged mergeable head through the observer. The server record drives merge --wait and names read failures with recovery. Automatic carried enrollment skips open corrections and names their PRs while other ready items enroll. The skipped item remains carried for the first release after its landing closes. Admission and containment reconcile stale closed or merged GitHub PRs with the real outcome; explicit add-item and containment still refuse an open correction. A member removed from the run never blocks it. A failed train refuses unchanged head/base inputs. Fix the cause on the lane, commit and re-verify. For an unrelated cause, file feedback, promote the fix item, record a dependency and park while the gate stays red. A missing web URL is derived from the identified Actions run id and repository. Automatic conflict re-entry requests Contents: write as well as Pull requests: write. An explicit hold suppresses stopped notices across pushes until fresh arming or queue entry. A failed-disarm notice names yoke github merge-queue hold <item>; run it before pushing a fix and re-entering merge item. A retained UNMERGEABLE entry with unknown mergeability stops waiting when the current unchanged head/base train has failed or timed out; the holder receives the failed-train-unchanged reason and run URL without automatic re-enqueue. A base conflict keeps its rebase recovery.
